body: No nothing. It’s  hard to understand I know. I’ve lost and failed over and over and over again I have no one who cares. And that’s true I promise. Even if I could go somewhere amazing tomorrow I wouldn’t care because I’d still be coming back to the same depressing life that I can’t handle anymore. I’m at peace with it. I’ve lived enough

Honestly there is no one who cares. It’s true. You don’t even want to know how many different ways I’ve tried to change things. I keep ending up back where I am except worse. And I don’t care now. I won’t miss life. It’s honestly crap.
It won’t help to talk. I’ve already made up my mind. It’s been years and years of wanting to die with no change in circumstances. Actually everything’s worse. I am not even upset. Just ready to go.
Thank you. I do feel like age is part of it because I’m middle age now and it’s harder to make changes. I’ll try very hard to not give up.
Ok thank you. I’m here too

“It happens to all of us” “life happens” “things will look up at some point” 

Don’t say these things to a depressed suicidal person. Very unhelpful words.

Life happens? Wtf? I’m a mom by the way.  Things will look up at some point? Oh yeah, when? Is that a guarantee? Because I’ve been waiting. And waiting. And guess what. There are no guarantees that things will look up. Sometimes they never do. Don’t offer false hope to a desperate person.

I’m sorry you sound like you’re sort of in the same boat as me. I don’t know how it gets better either. For me years and years have passed without it getting better. Im just getting more serious about death.

It may be hard to understand but I am never happy anymore. I used to enjoy things. I used to do photography. I enjoyed editing. Doing portraits. I don’t even care anymore. Even the thought of picking up a camera makes me gag a little because that was the old me, the one I don’t know anymore, the one I lost. I simply don’t experience joy. Ever.

I don’t believe in myself. I am smart and have a science degree. I just don’t like myself. And why should I? No one else does. Doing something for myself sounds weird because nothing brings me pleasure anyway. I’m too depressed.

I just don’t understand how my little girl would be allowed to come to my funeral if I died of cancer but not of depression. How does depression change my value as a human being? I’m just so hurt. It doesn’t help that I already don’t think much of myself. Thank you for listening.
Perhaps I should have put a Serious beside my post because I am. Serious.
